title: S04 — Project registers
body:
# S04 — Project registers

## Risks

Carried on the programme register; S04's live risks are the shared build target (R5) and the
served-spec drift (a lock failure), both reviewed at the tranche cadence.

## Issues

The legacy type-less artefact rows are a data-quality finding recorded for the repository; the
close uses the typed rows.

## Assumptions

The lock is regenerated only from a clean build; the preflight is the compile verdict.

## Dependencies

S02, S03; tranche 3; the action registry's consumers.

## Benefits

B4 and B6; both deliverables credited at the tranche-3 demo (`01a2054b-578c…`, `01a2054b-57f5…`).

## Changes

`01a2054b-3f86…` — accept the deliverables with evidence (approved).
